# Travel Hub (Travel-Hub Sagl)

> Bespoke Travel Experiences. B2B group travel company: Travel Hub designs and operates group trips for travel agencies, tour operators, associations and companies, in the USA and Canada, the Nordics (Norway, Iceland, Finnish Lapland, Sweden, Denmark) and other destinations on request.

- Services: small group tours, accommodation, transfers and transport, guides and tour leaders, travel assistance, activities and attractions, meals, incentives and business travel, self-drive and private tours.
- Offices: head office in Salita Cuccarello 4b, 6934 Bioggio, Switzerland (+41 76 483 36 96); US office in Manhattan, New York, NY 10022 (+1 646 269 7133); Italy (+39 328 211 34 97).
- Contact: sales@travel-hub.biz
- Since: 2016. IATA 96001872. Languages: English, Italian.
